meanings.en: a chemical substance that kills bacteria and germs
meanings.exampleEn: She wiped the kitchen counter with disinfectant.
meanings.exampleTr: Mutfak tezgahını dezenfektanla sildi.

meanings.en: in a cheerful and happy way
meanings.exampleEn: The children played merrily in the garden.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar bahçede neşeyle oynadılar.

meanings.en: the process by which businesses and cultures spread across the world
meanings.exampleEn: Globalization has connected economies around the world.
meanings.exampleTr: Küreselleşme dünyadaki ekonomileri birbirine bağladı.

meanings.en: a policy of avoiding involvement in other countries' affairs
meanings.exampleEn: The country's isolationism kept it out of international alliances.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülkenin yalıtımcılığı onu uluslararası ittifaklardan uzak tuttu.

meanings.en: a situation where there is more of something than is needed
meanings.exampleEn: An oversupply of oil caused prices to fall sharply.
meanings.exampleTr: Petrol arz fazlası fiyatların keskin şekilde düşmesine neden oldu.

meanings.tr: kendi kendine motive olan kişi, girişken çalışan
meanings.en: a person who is motivated to work without needing others to encourage them
meanings.exampleEn: We are looking for a self-starter who can work independently.
meanings.exampleTr: Bağımsız çalışabilen, kendi kendine motive olan biri arıyoruz.

meanings.en: an energetic, aggressively enterprising person
meanings.exampleEn: He's a real hustler who never stops looking for new deals.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni fırsatlar aramaktan hiç vazgeçmeyen tam bir işbitirici.

meanings.en: a person who obtains money in a dishonest or forceful way
meanings.exampleEn: The street hustler tried to trick tourists out of their cash.
meanings.exampleTr: Sokaktaki üçkağıtçı turistleri paralarından etmeye çalıştı.

meanings.tr: silip süpürmek, hızla ve açgözlülükle yemek
meanings.en: to eat something quickly and hungrily
meanings.exampleEn: The hungry boys devoured the whole pizza in minutes.
meanings.exampleTr: Aç çocuklar bütün pizzayı dakikalar içinde silip süpürdüler.

meanings.en: to read or take in something eagerly and quickly
meanings.exampleEn: She devoured every book in the series over the summer.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaz boyunca serideki her kitabı yutarcasına okudu.

meanings.en: the quality of being deeply religious or devoted
meanings.exampleEn: Her devoutness was evident in her daily prayers.
meanings.exampleTr: Dindarlığı günlük dualarında belliydi.

meanings.en: the state of being irreligious or sinful
meanings.exampleEn: The preacher condemned the ungodliness of the city.
meanings.exampleTr: Vaiz şehrin günahkârlığını kınadı.

meanings.en: lack of respect for God or religion
meanings.exampleEn: His impiety shocked the members of the congregation.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun kutsala saygısızlığı cemaat üyelerini şoke etti.

meanings.en: impossible to control or govern
meanings.exampleEn: The crowd became ungovernable as tensions rose.
meanings.exampleTr: Gerginlik artınca kalabalık kontrol edilemez hale geldi.

meanings.en: a feeling of satisfaction from doing something meaningful
meanings.exampleEn: She found great fulfillment in her volunteer work.
meanings.exampleTr: Gönüllü çalışmalarında büyük bir tatmin buldu.

meanings.en: the act of achieving or completing something
meanings.exampleEn: The fulfillment of the contract took several months.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşmenin yerine getirilmesi birkaç ay sürdü.

meanings.en: making you feel annoyed because you cannot achieve what you want
meanings.exampleEn: It's frustrating when the internet keeps disconnecting.
meanings.exampleTr: İnternetin sürekli kesilmesi sinir bozucu.

meanings.en: comparative of large; of greater size
meanings.exampleEn: We need a larger table to fit everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesin sığması için daha büyük bir masaya ihtiyacımız var.

meanings.en: comparative of big; of greater size or importance
meanings.exampleEn: My new house is much bigger than the old one.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni evim eskisinden çok daha büyük.

meanings.en: comparative of small; of lesser size
meanings.exampleEn: Could I have a smaller portion, please?
meanings.exampleTr: Daha küçük bir porsiyon alabilir miyim, lütfen?

meanings.en: the leaves of a plant or tree
meanings.exampleEn: The autumn foliage turned brilliant shades of red and gold.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonbahar yaprakları parlak kırmızı ve altın tonlarına büründü.

meanings.en: dirty, especially in a way that is not very serious
meanings.exampleEn: The child came home with grubby hands and a torn shirt.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuk kirli elleri ve yırtık bir gömlekle eve geldi.

meanings.en: causing horror or disgust, often involving death or injury
meanings.exampleEn: The movie contained several gruesome scenes of violence.
meanings.exampleTr: Film birkaç tüyler ürpertici şiddet sahnesi içeriyordu.

meanings.en: feeling dizzy, unsteady, or slightly ill
meanings.exampleEn: I felt woozy after standing up too quickly.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok hızlı ayağa kalkınca başım döndü.

meanings.en: bitter, long-lasting resentment or ill feeling
meanings.exampleEn: They parted without rancour and remained friends.
meanings.exampleTr: Kin gütmeden ayrıldılar ve arkadaş kaldılar.

meanings.en: the long tube in the body through which food passes after the stomach
meanings.exampleEn: The intestines absorb nutrients from digested food.
meanings.exampleTr: Bağırsaklar sindirilen besinlerden besin öğelerini emer.

meanings.en: a person's hairstyle, especially an elaborate one
meanings.exampleEn: Her elegant coiffure took the stylist two hours to complete.
meanings.exampleTr: Zarif saç modelinin tamamlanması kuaförün iki saatini aldı.

meanings.en: with complete sincerity and commitment
meanings.exampleEn: I wholeheartedly support your decision to change careers.
meanings.exampleTr: Kariyer değiştirme kararını tüm kalbimle destekliyorum.

meanings.en: to become stiff, rigid, or tense
meanings.exampleEn: Her body stiffened when she heard the bad news.
meanings.exampleTr: Kötü haberi duyunca vücudu gerildi.

meanings.en: to make something firmer or stronger
meanings.exampleEn: They stiffened the fabric with starch.
meanings.exampleTr: Kumaşı kolayla sertleştirdiler.

meanings.en: the quality of behaving as though you are superior to others
meanings.exampleEn: His superciliousness made him unpopular with his colleagues.
meanings.exampleTr: Tepeden bakan tavrı, meslektaşları arasında sevilmemesine yol açtı.

meanings.en: fast, energetic, and rather uncontrolled
meanings.exampleEn: The office had a frenetic pace during the busy season.
meanings.exampleTr: Ofis yoğun sezonda telaşlı bir tempoya sahipti.

meanings.en: paying careful attention to something
meanings.exampleEn: She was always heedful of her parents' advice.
meanings.exampleTr: Her zaman anne babasının öğütlerine kulak verirdi.

meanings.tr: hantallık, büyük ve yer kaplayan olma hali
meanings.en: the quality of being large and awkward to carry or handle
meanings.exampleEn: The bulkiness of the package made it hard to carry.
meanings.exampleTr: Paketin hantallığı taşınmasını zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: a person or thing that comes after another and takes their place
meanings.exampleEn: The CEO named her successor before retiring.
meanings.exampleTr: CEO emekli olmadan önce halefini açıkladı.

meanings.en: a person who receives money, property, or a title from someone who has died
meanings.exampleEn: As the sole inheritor, she received the entire estate.
meanings.exampleTr: Tek mirasçı olarak tüm mülkü aldı.

meanings.en: the quality of giving help, encouragement, or emotional support
meanings.exampleEn: Her supportiveness helped him through a difficult time.
meanings.exampleTr: Destekleyiciliği, zor bir dönemi atlatmasına yardım etti.

meanings.en: the quality of not being helpful or willing to assist
meanings.exampleEn: The staff's unhelpfulness frustrated the customers.
meanings.exampleTr: Personelin yardımcı olmaması müşterileri sinirlendirdi.

meanings.en: great courage, especially in battle
meanings.exampleEn: The soldier was awarded a medal for his valor.
meanings.exampleTr: Asker cesareti için bir madalyayla ödüllendirildi.

meanings.en: the quality of being extremely unpleasant or disgusting
meanings.exampleEn: The repulsiveness of the smell made everyone leave the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Kokunun iğrençliği herkesin odayı terk etmesine neden oldu.

meanings.en: something that is very large and extremely ugly
meanings.exampleEn: That new building is an absolute monstrosity.
meanings.exampleTr: O yeni bina tam bir ucube.

meanings.en: a small, rounded hill
meanings.exampleEn: They had a picnic on a grassy knoll overlooking the valley.
meanings.exampleTr: Vadiye bakan çimenli bir tepecikte piknik yaptılar.

meanings.en: a small hill or mound, especially in a marshy area
meanings.exampleEn: The path wound around a series of grassy hummocks.
meanings.exampleTr: Patika bir dizi çimenli tümseğin etrafından kıvrılıyordu.

meanings.en: the bubbles in a liquid, or the sound they make
meanings.exampleEn: The fizz of the soda tickled her nose.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazozun köpürmesi burnunu gıdıkladı.

meanings.en: to produce bubbles and a hissing sound
meanings.exampleEn: The tablet began to fizz as it dissolved in water.
meanings.exampleTr: Tablet suda çözünürken fışırdamaya başladı.

meanings.en: to make a hissing sound, like food frying in hot oil
meanings.exampleEn: The bacon began to sizzle in the hot pan.
meanings.exampleTr: Domuz pastırması sıcak tavada cızırdamaya başladı.

meanings.en: a person who is very enthusiastic about and knowledgeable in a particular subject
meanings.exampleEn: As a wine aficionado, he could identify the vintage instantly.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir şarap tutkunu olarak yılını hemen tanıyabiliyordu.

meanings.en: the state of being holy, sacred, or deserving great respect
meanings.exampleEn: They believe in the sanctity of human life.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsan hayatının kutsallığına inanıyorlar.

meanings.en: the quality of being holy and deserving respect
meanings.exampleEn: The sacredness of the temple was respected by all visitors.
meanings.exampleTr: Tapınağın kutsallığına tüm ziyaretçiler saygı gösterdi.
